THE_NUMBER: 5 of 5 retractions came from the metric / coordinate / over-read side. 0 of 12 load-bearing spectral, algebraic or representation-theoretic claims failed.

290+291 sqrt21 is a metric invariant.cause: coordinate choice; realization space continuous even under C2

275 det(B) = |ambient|.cause: det(B_3)=76 not 81; 16=2^4 was a p=2 coincidence

300 Koide's field unreachable.cause: quantified over ONE geometry; the ladder has many rungs

305 a genuine tie to the substrate.cause: AGL(1,7) does not embed; 7 does not divide 51840

tautologies_deflated_separately.281's 'trace law' Tr(B_p) = (p^2+1)(p+2): deflated by 287 -- true but vacuous (Tr is DEFINED as rank_p(t=1)-1 and t=1 never drops)
tautologies_deflated_separately.305's '42 = 2*q*Phi_6' reading: deflated in 305/309 -- holds at q=3 only because Phi_6-1 = 6 = 2q there; a small-case coincidence

why_it_is_not_luck: Representation theory and spectra have no coordinates to be fooled by: a rank, an eigenvalue multiplicity, an invariant factor and a branching rule are all basis-free by construction. A polyhedron always arrives with a drawing and a matrix always arrives with a basis, so a claim about either has to be checked against every other valid drawing or basis -- and this program repeatedly did not, until Pass 293 made it a habit.
the_two_over_reads_are_their_own_categor: Passes 300 and 305 were not metric errors -- both were TRUE. They failed by being read wider than they were proved: 300 quantified over one geometry and was quoted as being about the substrate; 305 established a forced automorphism group and was quoted as a structural tie. So there are two distinct failure modes -- coordinate artefacts, and correct results over-stated -- and the second is the harder one to catch, because the pass itself is right.
the_operational_prior: Trust spectral/algebraic/representation-theoretic claims by default; treat metric or basis-dependent claims as provisional until a second realization or basis is checked; and treat any claim whose scope is wider than its proof as an over-read regardless of which side it came from. On this arc's evidence that prior would have caught all five failures before they were published.
